title: Global exponential stabilization of a force- and torque-actuated unicycle by flexible-step MPC
summary: We study the problem of global exponential stabilization of a force- and torque-controlled unicycle model in discrete time. To this end, we extend a recently introduced approach to model predictive control (MPC) in which a flexible number of inputs is implemented in every iteration. We present the first flexible-step MPC protocol with state-dependent weights for average descent. Notably, the proposed method relies neither on a suitable design of running or terminal cost functions nor on a suitable choice of terminal constraints.
